parts.title: Low Tide
parts.text: Pia, Sam, and Dara went to the beach with Dad. Dad said it was low tide, so the water would **recede** and show them a secret world. The air smelled **salty**, and the wet sand felt cool under their feet.

parts.title: The Tide Pool
parts.text: Big rocks made little pools full of clear water. The children had to **clamber** over the rocks to reach them. Dara pointed at an orange **starfish** stuck to a rock. A tiny crab began to **scuttle** sideways across the sand. Pia touched a rock that felt cold and **slimy**.

parts.title: Sea Surprises
parts.text: A piece of green **seaweed** floated in the water. Under it, a dark **mussel** held on tight. It could **clamp** its shell shut if anything came near. A small worm began to **wriggle** out of the wet sand. A long, thin eel began to **slither** between the rocks. When Sam touched a sea animal, it sent a **squirt** of water into the air. Everyone laughed.

parts.title: Back Home
parts.text: Soon the water began to come back. The children said goodbye to the tide pool. They promised to be gentle with every living thing they saw.
